title: Anthropic Claude Credit (API key) 30% cheaper
author: Flaky-Mail-2889
selftext:
Hi Everybody, 

A few months back we (My company) have purchased around 15K worth of Anthropic claude Credit. 

We are now closing down the company, so we have now 13K-14K (USD) left on the account.   
we are willing to sell it at 30% cheaper than what we bought.   
Would anyone be interested in it ?

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body:
Why would I do it free, hahaha? 
I'm giving away at around 10k something that literally worth 14k

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: You're selling for 10k what you paid 14k for. You are not "giving it away".

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: You can give away 14k. You're still selling.

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body:
True, 
But what dose it change in the fact that this is a bargain really.

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body: Why would I come down to 500bucks ?

comments.author: Busy-Tower-1549
comments.body: yes indian man i will buy

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: sure I completely trust this not a stolen key or anyhting 😅

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body:
Well, 
It's not how can I prove that it's not ?

comments.author: Annual-Kiwi4096
comments.body: Honestly, it sounds not legit. Can you show something that will increase the trust?

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body:
Thinking about it right now, 
What do you think how can I do that ?

replies.author: Annual-Kiwi4096
replies.body:
How about let's discuss how will it happen. I don't know of any mechanism of changing the ownership of credits. So how will it happen? Am I supposed to connect to your account? This is dangerous, because i don't know how you did that. 
Frankly, I think that your best bet is too ask the LLM company for partial refund

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body:
Good one, 
I'm starting to realize that well, I might just use it for some personal project, cuz apparently it looks way too scamy for the community

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Why not use it to build something else? Why give it away? Thats a lot of credits and it sounds you aren't using them to their full potential.

replies.author: Flaky-Mail-2889
replies.body:
I definitely am not, 
I have another company which I have an enterprise account on. 

So I'm using that one mainly.

comments.author: HLCYSWAP
comments.body: you should do 40% and sliding scale payment. eg for every $100 of used credits the buyer pays $60. this would help this not entirely look like a scam.

replies.body:
I'm file doing that, 
I can drop an API key here and mintor the usage, once it goes above the 100$ i`ll delete it, dose that sounds good as proof ?
